declared_deviations.what: no separate terminal Adj event is emitted
declared_deviations.why: spec §3 recomputes after every registration and the vendored P0 Harness does exactly that inside each registration event, but it exposes no public Adj emitter; the import writes through the registration API only and never forges a log line, so the terminal adjudication is the state after the last event

declared_deviations.what: imported FCL problem records use SpawnTrigger.SEED
declared_deviations.why: the vendored enum has no 'import' member; 'seed' is the only trigger that does not assert an in-graph derivation. The clean fix is an enum addition, requested rather than papered over

declared_deviations.what: research problems use SpawnTrigger.RESEARCH with empty criteria
declared_deviations.why: the vendored enum has the member and §12 is exactly this path, but the trigger is not part of the v1.3 enum text; criteria stay empty because no instantiated commitment id is a criterion

declared_deviations.what: document-local depends refs are dropped, not turned into dep edges
declared_deviations.why: at node granularity they would be dep self-loops, i.e. cycles; toposort rejects them and a self-loop asserts nothing the author declared

declared_deviations.what: a self-targeting objection mints no warrant
declared_deviations.why: a Dung self-attack means 'this argument is self-defeating', which is not what an intra-document caveat asserts; minting it would flip two labels for reasons that have nothing to do with the evidence

declared_deviations.what: an objection against a record this import reified as a warrant attacks that warrant's validity node, not the node artifact
declared_deviations.why: spec §1 closure: attackers of a validity node attack the warrant and every carrier of it, so criticism of a criticism keeps its force instead of collapsing into a plain edge onto the carrier

declared_deviations.what: the retargeting rule above has ONE exception: an objection against a criticism carried by the SAME artifact is not retargeted
declared_deviations.why: the §1 closure lifts an attack on a validity node onto every carrier of the warrant, and for an intra-document criticism of a criticism that carrier is the objector itself, so retargeting would mint a self-attack through the closure and make the artifact self-defeating - which is not what an author asserts by qualifying their own earlier objection. `objection.o4` against `o1`/`o2` is exactly this case; it is dropped, not retargeted, and counted under its own code so the loss is visible rather than silent

declared_deviations.what: an FCL `claim` record maps to no spec construct
declared_deviations.why: a claim asserts content without proposing a test, so it is neither an observation-valued commitment nor a criticism nor a problem; it survives in the artifact body and in the FCL-1 document artifact, and is reported here because `uptake_refs_unmapped` covers only the claims the author put in `uptake`

problems.description: I share a flat with two friends. We keep arguing about ordinary household chores. Sometimes we agree on who will do something, but later we disagree about what the agreement meant. Our work schedules change, and one friend has started avoiding the conversations. What should I do?

The cause of the friend's avoidance cannot be determined from the asker's description. At least two opposite explanations fit — feeling unfairly blamed or outnumbered, or dodging obligations the friend knows are unmet — and they call for different responses. Resolving this requires input the account does not have.

Where the line sits between enough explicitness to prevent disputes and so much that coordination feels like contract enforcement among friends is household-specific and cannot be settled from the asker's description; it will have to be found by trying the lighter measures first and watching how they land.

Which reading of the manager signature holds — exploited coordinator or over-manager — cannot be settled from the asker's side of the description; it needs the bounded stop-test plus the other two residents' own accounts of the problem.
How to announce the stop-initiating test so it is not heard as a strike or retaliation is unresolved; the framing carries most of the experiment's risk.
How much of this household's coordination is actually reducible is unknown until the inventory conversation happens; kitchen-type spaces may cap the shrink-the-surface route.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/account#k1): Propose that when a chore agreement is made, the person taking the task records it in a shared place (group chat or shared note) in their own words, including what the task covers and how often or by when.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/account#k2): Propose a short, recurring, scheduled check-in (roughly fifteen minutes, fortnightly) with a fixed agenda: what did not work since last time, and what needs adjusting for the coming period given schedule changes.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/account#k3): Propose that the asker approach the avoiding friend one-on-one, in a low-stakes setting, asking what would make the chore arrangements easier for them — framed as a question, not as a summons back into the group conversation.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/rival#p1): Shrink the coordination surface before clarifying it: one inventory conversation with the other two marking every currently shared obligation keep, clarify or eliminate, then a four-to-six-week trial of eliminating two or three contested obligations (own-food arrangements, fewer shared items, a tool that deletes a task), watching dispute frequency.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/rival#p2): Where spillover is low, replace task-by-task negotiation with domain ownership: each resident owns at least one zone outright, including standard and timing, and the owner's word settles disputes inside it; negotiation survives only for irreducibly shared spaces.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/rival#p3): Test the manager hypothesis with an announced, bounded stop on initiating and following up (about two weeks): say in advance that it is an experiment, then record who steps up, what degrades, and what the others say.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/rival#p4): Make the unclaimed-task default explicit: within hygiene and safety limits, unclaimed work goes undone, visibly, and the household absorbs the consequence rather than the most-concerned resident absorbing the task.

Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/rival#p5): For the avoiding friend, change the medium before the message: try an asynchronous claiming channel (a shared list, no face, no meeting) before any one-on-one outreach, falling back to the input account's one-on-one approach only if it produces silent non-participation.
